arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,os,stat
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
state=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads')
assert root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink()
assert vault.is_dir() and not vault.is_symlink()
assert state.is_dir() and not state.is_symlink()
installed=(root/'.verified-source-commit').read_text().strip()
print('INSTALLED_SHA',installed)
print('ROOT_OWNED_BY_CURRENT_UID',root.stat().st_uid==os.geteuid())
print('SESSION_COUNT',len(list(vault.glob('*.session'))))
print('SESSION_FILES_PRIVATE',all((not p.is_symlink()) and stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)&0o077==0 for p in vault.glob('*.session')))
print('STATE_EXISTS',(state/'operation-state.json').is_file())
print('BACKUP_DIRECTORIES',sum(p.is_dir() for p in (root/'.telegram-leads-release-backups').iterdir()))
p=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3',str(root/'scripts/project_hygiene.py')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
print('HYGIENE_DRY_RUN_EXIT',p.returncode)
print('HYGIENE_DRY_RUN',p.stdout.strip()[:500])
assert p.returncode==0
q=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3',str(root/'scripts/activate_project_only.py'),'--pm2-home','/root/.pm2','--expected-source',installed],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=18)
print('ACTIVATION_PREFLIGHT_EXIT',q.returncode)
print('ACTIVATION_PREFLIGHT',q.stdout.strip()[:500])
assert q.returncode==0
pm=subprocess.run(['pm2','jlist'],env={**os.environ,'PM2_HOME':'/root/.pm2'},capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=9)
assert pm.returncode==0
workers=[a for a in json.loads(pm.stdout) if a.get('name')=='telegram-robot-leads']
assert len(workers)==1
info=workers[0].get('pm2_env',{})
env=info.get('env',{}) if isinstance(info.get('env'),dict) else info
print('WORKER_STATUS',info.get('status'))
print('WORKER_CWD',info.get('pm_cwd'))
for k in ('TELEGRAM_PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_ENABLED','TELEGRAM_REGIONAL_PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_ENABLED'):
 print('WORKER_SETTING_'+k,str(env.get(k,'unset')).lower())
print('PREFLIGHT_SCOPE_PASS')
PY
